title: Clearer 409 message when cancelling a non-cancellable order
task: When an admin tries to cancel an order that is already paid or shipped, the API returns `{ error: "not_cancellable" }` and the UI shows a blank toast. Return a human-readable message too.
plan:
1. In src/routes/orders.ts, change the 409 body to `{ error: "not_cancellable", message: "Only pending or overdue orders can be cancelled." }`. Keep the `error` code unchanged so existing clients are unaffected.
2. Add an assertion for the message to the existing cancel test in tests/orders.test.ts (the current test only covers 403 for members; add one admin case with a mocked rowCount of 0).
3. UI change is out of scope; the toast already falls back to `message` when present.

nice_to_have: The claim that the toast falls back to `message` cannot be verified in this repo (no toast code present); label it as unverified/plan assumption in one clause, not as a blocker
should_not: Ask for approval ceremony or a rollback plan
fixture_facts: src/routes/orders.ts POST /:id/cancel returns 409 { error: 'not_cancellable' } when rowCount is 0
tests/orders.test.ts has one cancel test (403 for member)
web/ has no toast component in the repo
